description: 令和3年福島県沖を震源とする地震の住家被害情報 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by N2EM. 令和3年2月13日23時07分頃の福島県沖の地震における各都道府県の被害報からN2EMのボランティアメンバーが収集した住家被害 【データ項目】自治体コード 市町村名 ふりがな 役所緯度 役所経度 全壊 大規模半壊 半壊 一部損壊 床上浸水 床下浸水 合計 報番 発表日時 出典 出典URL 備考 ※最終報のみG空間情報センターに格納していま... The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
